Grants <strand/>Arcane Needles <barrier/>Shield-Piercing properties.

Scoring an <strand/>Arcane Needle hit on an enemy marks them with a vertical mark for 10 seconds. Marked Enemies explode on death, releasing a <strand/>Suspending Blast that <strand/>Suspends and damages targets in a 10 meter radius.

<strand/>Suspending Blast damage by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
Players: 40, Minors: 80, Elites: 120, Minibosses: 160, Bosses: 200

Landing 2 <strand/>Arcane Needle hits on a Marked Enemy triggers <strand/>Suspending Blast that deals 2x damage.

Landing 5 <strand/>Needlestorm Hits on a single enemy triggers a <strand/>Suspending Blast that deals 11x damage and inherits Super damage buffs.

<strand/>Arcane Needle Kills and Killing <strand/>Suspended targets grant Melee Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 15%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22.2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 33%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 100%
